artifacts.author: Charles Daprix
artifacts.content_summary: Single-page overview of export process. Describes C-CDA 2.1 XML and PDF export in ZIP format. 4-step process: Patients > Download Patient Chart > select params > Request Documents > Export. Contains internal note: 'This should comply with what we need and buy us time to finish the feature in the overall direction we are thinking.'

artifacts.author: Charles Daprix
artifacts.content_summary: Lists all 27 certified criteria with brief descriptions and cost information. (b)(10) entry states export creates file(s) with 'all of a single patient's or population of patient's electronic health information.' No additional technical detail. States costs are included in license fees.
Full-page screenshot showing document links including the b10 PDF, CEHRT disclosures, compliance certificates, and real-world testing reports.
